name: Kawsah Tools
description: Educational mortgage-planning tools. Estimates only — not loan offers, approvals, or eligibility determinations. Functions live in src/lib/calc-network.js and are UI-free/pure so they can be exposed to compatible systems later.

tools.name: calculateAffordability
tools.description: Estimate a home purchase price from user-provided income, debts, down payment, and rate assumptions.

tools.name: calculateMortgagePayment
tools.description: Estimate a monthly mortgage payment (principal & interest, optionally taxes, insurance, HOA, PMI).

tools.name: calculateCashToClose
tools.description: Estimate cash needed to close: down payment plus closing costs and prepaids, less credits.

tools.name: calculateRefiBreakeven
tools.description: Estimate the number of months required to recover refinance closing costs from monthly savings.

tools.name: calculateDTI
tools.description: Estimate front-end and back-end debt-to-income ratios from monthly income, debts, and housing payment.

tools.name: calculateDownPayment
tools.description: Convert between a down payment percentage and dollar amount for a given price.

tools.name: findKawsahRoute
tools.description: Identify the appropriate educational/financing-navigation route from a user's stated intent. Navigation only; never an eligibility decision.

disclaimer: All tools produce estimates for education and planning. Results depend on assumptions and do not represent loan offers, approvals, rates, or guarantees.

plannedFunctions.name: calculateQualifyingIncome
plannedFunctions.description: Estimate qualifying income for self-employed borrowers (specialized — see Mitig8).

plannedFunctions.name: findBusinessCapitalRoute
plannedFunctions.description: Route business-capital needs to the right funding pathway.

plannedFunctions.name: findFinancialReadinessRoute
plannedFunctions.description: Route a user to financial-readiness resources based on their obstacle.

plannedFunctions.name: findInvestmentRoute
plannedFunctions.description: Route investment-property scenarios to the right financing pathway.

plannedFunctions.name: findProfessionalRoute
plannedFunctions.description: Route real-estate professionals to the right toolkit.

plannedFunctions.name: homeownerToolRoute
plannedFunctions.description: Route homeowners to the right post-close tool.

plannedFunctions.name: houseHuntingWorkspace
plannedFunctions.description: Organize and compare candidate homes in a workspace.
